g.text: description: Estimate per-spot cell type proportions with CARD…
Wrong matrix orientation — CARD wants genes × cells; AnnData is cells × genes.
Transpose on export: `adata.X.T` before writing the count matrix.
Assert `rownames(sc_meta) == colnames(sc_count)` before fitting — misaligned names drop spots silently.
